_comment: Structured rights for every source in the packs. release_excerpt says whether the retained excerpt may appear in a public release; a link to the source is always fine. Unverified sources default to withhold until their terms are read. This sidecar is kept outside the review database, which is append-only; see docs/recommendations/10-assets-and-licences.md.

_comment_snapshot_policy: snapshot_policy says whether fetched bytes may be kept in the local object store: store, hash_only (keep the hash, size and headers, discard the bytes) or none. Set to store for every source on 2026-09-24 at the user's direction: private, local-only research use under fair use, with publication filtered later by the release gate (`check_licences.py --mode release`). The object store is git-ignored (.local/) and is never published.
